ios.desc:
Hey Sunrise: Sunrise & Sunset Times

Never miss a perfect sunrise or sunset again! Hey Sunrise delivers precise sun timing information (including sunrise and sunset) with recurring sunrise and sunset alarms, customizable sunrise/sunset notifications, beautiful widgets, an interactive map for exploring sunrise and sunsets, and detailed solar data for any location worldwide, all displayed in a simplistic, ad-free user interface. 

Perfect for:

- Photographers capturing sunrise, sunset, golden hour, or blue hour
- Outdoor enthusiasts planning activities around sunrise and sunset
- People practicing sunrise meditation or yoga
- Travelers adjusting to different time zones
- Gardeners monitoring sunlight exposure
- Homebuyers who want to check where the sun rises and sets in their new backyard
- Anyone who appreciates nature's daily rhythm

Key Features:

Sun Alarms

- Set customizable alarms for sunrise and sunset
- Configure alarms to trigger up to 120 minutes before or after sunrise and sunset
- Select specific days of the week for alarms to trigger
- Advanced alarm settings like snooze and countdown

Smart Notifications

- Set customizable alerts for sunrise and sunset
- Configure notifications up to 120 minutes before or after sunrise and sunset
- Select specific days of the week for notifications to trigger
- Maximize sunshine and never miss the perfect lighting conditions again

Beautiful Home Screen Widgets

- 6 different widget styles to choose from showing sunrise, sunset, and other solar data
- Display your most important sun data at a glance

Interactive Sun Angle Map

- Track the sun’s position on a map
- View what direction the sun is coming from when the sun rises and sets
- Follow the path of the sun throughout the day
- Explore the direction of the sun for any time, date, or location
- Watch how the sun patterns change throughout the year

Comprehensive Sun Information

- Precise sunrise and sunset times for any location
- Total daylight hours and daily daylight change
- Solar noon times
- Astronomical, nautical, and civil twilight times
- Golden hour and blue hour times
- Detailed day-by-day sun information
- Solstice information, including summer solstice dates and winter solstice dates

Location Management

- Automatic GPS location detection
- Search for any location worldwide
- Save and organize favorite locations
- Quick switching between multiple saved locations
- Choose locations for your widgets

Personalization Options

- Choose betwee

quotes.text: Hey folks! This is my first iOS app. I’m an Android developer by trade, but have recently been interested in learning some iOS as well. This app is the product of my learning over the last month or so. It’s built entirely with Swift UI. I built an Android app with the same functionality a number of years ago and it has been relatively successful (200k+ installs, 4.8* rating), so I wanted to make an iOS equivalent. There are a number of apps already on the App Store that have similar functionality, but I’m not a huge fan of their UI and most of them require a subscription for the main features.
